mobbin:7f182913-8d7d-4483-ac22-3ef0275de.summary: Watch a LIVE event with skip-back controls, browse Related highlights under the player, then open a related Day sheet with Watch now and Share.
steps: Related Day sheet: Watch now / Share
steal: Step 1: Related horizontal gallery under the player ('Highlights from this competition') keeps clips adjacent to the main recording.
Step 1: −10s skip on the LIVE player for quick rewinds without leaving the event.
Step 2: Sheet actions Watch now + Share keep jump-to-related-session and share in one dismissible overlay.
avoid: Candidate claimed multi-camera switching; screens show related days/highlights only — do not treat as camera-views evidence.
mobbin:7f182913-8d7d-4483-ac22-3ef0275de.fit: Closer to rewatch + highlight browsing beside a main playback than to PTZ/360 switching; Cast/AirPlay icons hint handoff but no paired big-screen UI.
